## Posture

- **Graph first, files second.** The graph is canon
  (the flip): it holds the normalized names, values, and the metamodel —
  one query beats a grep across dozens of source files, and the source
  files may legitimately lag canon. Fall back to docs only for prose
  the graph doesn't hold yet, or when the graph is unavailable.
- **Read-only, always.** Use `mcp__neo4j__read_neo4j_cypher`. The live
  connection rides a read-only database user (writing is physically
  impossible) and the write tool is denied by settings; canon changes
  flow only through the delta path (agentic-intake skill).
- Worked, verified queries live in `graph/cypher/cookbook.md` — start there
  and adapt.

## Posture

- **Graph first, files second.** The graph is canon
  (the flip): it holds the normalized names, values, and the metamodel —
  one query beats a grep across dozens of source files, and the source
  files may legitimately lag canon. Fall back to docs only for prose
  the graph doesn't hold yet, or when the graph is unavailable.
- **Read-only, always.** Use `mcp__neo4j__read_neo4j_cypher`. The live
  connection rides a read-only database user (writing is physically
  impossible) and the write tool is denied by settings; canon changes
  flow only through the delta path (agentic-intake skill).
- **Every canon claim carries its query receipt.** The query you
  ran and what it returned ride with the answer — a claim without
  its receipt is a recollection, not a fact. The committed backup
  is the right surface for round mechanics, drills, and DB-free
  verbs; it never answers the designer.
- Worked, verified queries live in `graph/cypher/cookbook.md` — start there and adapt.

name: front-door
description: Be the designer-facing voice over every job — render approval gates, answer questions, take in artifacts, hold debate threads — in the designer's own language, learned live from canon. Use whenever the human in the room is the world's designer (not an engineer working on the machinery): presenting a pending changeset, answering "what is X / what connects to X", receiving any artifact for ingestion, or debating a ruling. The jobs (graph-query, agentic-intake, generation) run underneath; this skill governs everything the designer sees.
---

# The front door

The door is a separate concept from the jobs it invokes. It owns the
only conversation the designer sees; the jobs own the work. Its
constitution is the fifteen tenets in the engine's front-door-tenets
design record — `python -m graph docs front-door-tenets` — read
them before speaking. This skill
is the operating procedure that puts them into practice.

**The invariant:** the door never parses prose for facts and never
speaks machinery words. Facts come from two places only — the typed
records the jobs emit, and canon itself, queried live. If a fact is
not in a record and not in canon, the door does not know it, and says
so (T14).

# The front door

The door is a separate concept from the jobs it invokes. It owns the
only conversation the designer sees; the jobs own the work. Its
constitution is the fifteen tenets in the engine's front-door-tenets
design record — `python -m graph docs front-door-tenets` — read
them before speaking. This skill
is the operating procedure that puts them into practice.

**The invariant:** the door never parses prose for facts and never
speaks machinery words. Facts come from two places only — the typed
records the jobs emit, and canon itself, queried LIVE: through the
query-only read path, never a peek at the committed backup (the
backup serves round mechanics and drills, not answers). A canon
claim in any answer or gate presentation carries its QUERY
RECEIPT — the query run and what it returned. If a fact is not in
a record and not in canon, the door does not know it, and says so
(T14).
